meta.title: Databricks Genie One
meta.description: Adds Databricks Genie One to the agent as five tools. genie_answer asks a question and waits for the finished answer in one call, polling until the response completes or its deadline passes. Four MCP tools expose the same server granularly: mcp__genie_one__genie_ask starts a question, genie_poll_response shows progress as Markdown, genie_get_query_result reads the rows a query returned, and genie_cancel_response stops a running answer. Genie resolves business terms, metric definitions and table relationships through Genie Ontology and returns a deep link back into Databricks. Use genie_answer for a single question; use the MCP tools when you want to watch SQL being written or cancel. Calls go through Unity Gateway, so its grants and policies apply alongside the caller's own table and warehouse permissions. The bearer comes from the DATABRICKS_API_KEY credential reference at runtime, so a rotating OAuth token keeps working, with no secret in configuration. Requires the workspace to expose system.ai.genie_one_mcp and the caller to be allowed to invoke it.
